title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Residential Placement Band Rate Table
content:
**Placement band rate — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier, residential placement schedule.** The rate per 100 for a new placement is 0.88 when the required amount on the loan's first notice is 200000 dollars or more, 1.05 when it is below 100000 dollars, and the tier's building rate per 100 when it is at least 100000 but below 200000 dollars.

The required amount read is the one stated on the first notice of the loan being placed.

| Required amount on the loan's first notice | Rate per 100 for the new placement |
|---|---|
| Below 100000 dollars | 1.05 |
| At least 100000 dollars and below 200000 dollars | The tier's building rate per 100 |
| 200000 dollars or more | 0.88 |

## Band edges

| Required amount (illustrative) | Band | Rate per 100 |
|---|---|---|
| 99,999 dollars | Below 100000 | 1.05 |
| 100,000 dollars | From 100000 to below 200000 | The tier's building rate per 100 |
| 199,999 dollars | From 100000 to below 200000 | The tier's building rate per 100 |
| 200,000 dollars | 200000 or more | 0.88 |

Each edge belongs to the higher band: an amount of exactly 100000 dollars is no longer "below 100000 dollars", and an amount of exactly 200000 dollars is "200000 dollars or more".
